p2_remaining.title: the MEDIUM band stays thinly populated — 2 of 300 in the current month
p2_remaining.why: the matrix's LOW-T&A anchors top out at 40, the notch cap adds at most 16, and the override floors jump to 60 and 95, so the 50-74 window is reachable only from anchor 40 with two adverse notches. Methodology, not data. Documented rather than engineered away.

run_3.why_no_deterministic_test_caught_them: each needed a model to actually answer; with no provider configured every stage falls to its deterministic floor and every contract holds vacuously

rejected_figure_provenance.why_rejected: stored signed, written in words; the allowed set carried -11.31 and never 11.31
the numeral scanner read a hyphen between two word characters as a minus sign, so top-5 became -5 and tier-3 became -3. `5` alone was always allowed, which is the proof: a bare five would have passed

defects_fixed.title: the grounding guard rejected figures the packet was holding
defects_fixed.root_cause: a signed packet value permitted only its signed spelling; English carries direction in the verb
defects_fixed.fix: a packet value permits its size as well as its sign, in reading._allowed_figures
defects_fixed.residual_risk: a figure guard cannot catch a direction inversion; that is the composer's improved/deteriorated verdict and the deterministic reading shown alongside, and it is documented in the code

defects_fixed.title: no route existed for arithmetic the result implies
defects_fixed.root_cause: every figure had to be a literal packet cell, so a total, a share or a difference was unwritable
defects_fixed.fix: backend/early_warning/conversation/derivation.py — the model declares {value, op, refs}, the server resolves the refs in the packet's fact index, applies the operation itself and compares; disagreement permits nothing

defects_fixed.title: the numeral scanner read a hyphen as a minus sign
defects_fixed.root_cause: the lookbehind was (?<![\d.,\-]) and permitted a letter before the hyphen
defects_fixed.fix: (?<![\w.,\-]); this also stops L1, L3 and L1.2 being read as figures, which the system prompt asks the model to write

defects_fixed.title: sonnet_pass_2 lost a whole reading over the case of a letter
defects_fixed.root_cause: the stage had no tidy, so a closed enum was validated against the raw reply; l3, Layer 3, 'L3 external intelligence', ['L3'] and an explicit null each threw the pass away
defects_fixed.fix: normalise._pass_2_tidy maps each closed field into the schema's own vocabulary and drops what will not map; layer aliases resolve through layers.resolve, not a second list

defects_fixed.title: an incorrect premise was routed to What-If
defects_fixed.root_cause: the gate accepted any route OUT of Early Warning on the grounds that nothing analytical then runs; true of the controls, false of the reader
defects_fixed.fix: functionality.belongs_to_early_warning — an observed-state question with no stipulated change stays here; select._reconcile refuses the route-out. The word 'if' decides nothing on its own

a genuine scenario the patterns missed still leaves
